title: Site Development Input Schema
description: Field catalog for a land development site-planning app. Each field has an id, type, unit, default and range. Defaults are common US rules of thumb, not code requirements: anything with source 'local_code' or 'agency' must be replaced with the value from the governing jurisdiction.

conventions.coordinateSystem: Local site coordinates in feet, +x east, +y north, origin at the southwest corner of the parcel bounding box
conventions.elevationDatum: NAVD88 feet unless the survey states otherwise

fieldTypes.point: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in ft
fieldTypes.polygon: Array of points forming a closed ring, first point not repeated
fieldTypes.objectList: Array of objects whose shape is given in 'itemFields'

sourceValues.survey: Comes from the boundary/topographic survey, geotech report or other site data
sourceValues.local_code: Set by the local zoning or development code
sourceValues.standard: Set by a national standard (ADA, IFC, IBC, AASHTO) that local code may amend
sourceValues.agency: Set by a utility provider, DOT or other reviewing agency
sourceValues.design: A design choice made by the user

conventions.nullDefault: A default of null means there is no sensible generic value and the user must supply one

fields.label: Parcel boundary
fields.description: Property line vertices. When null the app can fall back to a rectangle built from grossAreaAcres and frontageLength.

fields.label: Gross parcel area
fields.description: Used only when boundary is null; otherwise area is computed from the boundary.

fields.label: Road frontage length
fields.description: Length of property line along the public right-of-way.

fields.label: Frontage side
fields.description: Which side of the parcel faces the primary road.

fields.label: Easements
fields.description: Areas with recorded restrictions. Buildings are normally excluded; paving is often allowed.

fields.label: Right-of-way dedication depth
fields.description: Strip along the frontage to be dedicated for future road widening. Setbacks are measured from the new line.

fields.label: Adjacent land uses
fields.description: Drives buffer width, since buffers are usually larger next to residential.

fields.label: Deed restrictions and covenants
fields.description: Free-text notes on title encumbrances.

fields.label: Zoning district
fields.description: District code, for example C-2 or RM-12.

fields.label: Proposed use
fields.description: Selecting a use loads the matching entry from usePresets.

fields.label: Entitlement path
fields.description: Whether the use is permitted outright or needs a discretionary approval.

fields.label: Front landscape strip
fields.description: Planted strip along the road; no paving except driveways.

fields.label: Buffer next to residential
fields.description: Replaces the side or rear buffer on any side listed as residential in parcel.adjacentUses.

fields.label: Maximum floor area ratio
fields.description: Gross floor area divided by gross site area.

fields.label: Maximum lot coverage
fields.description: Building footprint as a share of site area.

fields.label: Maximum impervious surface
fields.description: Buildings plus paving as a share of site area.

fields.label: Overlay districts
fields.description: Overlays add or tighten standards on top of the base district.

fields.label: Existing contours
fields.description: Existing ground contour lines from the topographic survey.

fields.label: Low point location
fields.description: Default candidate location for the stormwater pond.

fields.label: Average existing slope
fields.description: Used for quick earthwork estimates when contours are not loaded.

fields.label: Downhill direction
fields.description: Compass bearing of the fall line, 0 = north.

fields.label: Allowable soil bearing capacity
fields.description: From the geotechnical report.

fields.label: Depth to rock
fields.description: Shallow rock raises excavation and utility trench cost sharply.

fields.label: Required freeboard above BFE
fields.description: Commonly 1 to 3 ft.

fields.label: Stream buffer each side
fields.description: Measured from top of bank. State and local buffers often stack.

fields.label: Driveways
fields.description: Ingress and egress points onto the public road.

fields.label: Default driveway width
fields.description: Two-way commercial driveways typically run 24 to 36 ft.

fields.label: Minimum spacing between driveways
fields.description: Increases with road speed and classification.

fields.label: Required intersection sight distance
fields.description: AASHTO value for a left turn from stop at 35 mph. Scale with posted speed.

fields.label: Drive-through stacking spaces
fields.description: Restaurants commonly need 8 to 12, banks 4 to 6 per lane.

fields.label: Required spaces per 1,000 sq ft
fields.description: Loaded from usePresets when the use changes. Ignored when the use is unit-based.

fields.label: Required spaces per dwelling unit or room
Maximum spaces per 1,000 sq ft
fields.description: Some codes cap parking as well as requiring a minimum.

fields.label: Drive aisle width
fields.description: 24 ft for two-way with 90 degree stalls. One-way aisles run about 18 ft at 60 degrees and 13 ft at 45 degrees.

fields.label: Planning area per stall
fields.description: Stall plus its share of aisles and islands. Used for quick area estimates before a layout exists.

fields.label: Accessible access aisle width
fields.description: Van spaces use an 11 ft stall with a 5 ft aisle, or an 8 ft stall with an 8 ft aisle.

fields.label: Maximum slope in accessible stalls
fields.description: 1:48 in any direction.

fields.label: Truck court depth
fields.description: Clear depth in front of docks for tractor-trailer maneuvering.

fields.label: Design vehicle
fields.description: Largest vehicle whose turning path must clear curbs and stalls.

fields.label: Building footprint
fields.description: When null the app can place a rectangle sized from footprintArea.

fields.label: Building height
fields.description: Measured the way the local code measures it, usually average grade to roof or parapet.

fields.label: Occupancy group
fields.description: International Building Code occupancy classification.

fields.label: Fully sprinklered
fields.description: Affects allowable area, fire flow and hydrant distances.

fields.label: Finished floor elevation
fields.description: Must clear derived.minFinishedFloorElevation.

fields.label: Orientation
fields.description: Rotation of the footprint, 0 = long axis east-west.

fields.label: Building pad elevation
fields.description: Usually finished floor elevation minus slab and base thickness.

fields.label: Minimum pavement slope
fields.description: Below this, asphalt tends to pond.

fields.label: Accessible route maximum running slope
fields.description: 1:20. Anything steeper is a ramp.

fields.label: Ramp maximum slope
fields.description: 1:12, with landings every 30 in of rise.

fields.label: Steepest landscape slope
fields.description: 3 means 3 horizontal to 1 vertical. 2:1 normally needs stabilization.

fields.label: Slope away from building
fields.description: 5 percent for the first 10 ft over pervious ground, 2 percent over paving.

fields.label: Fill shrinkage factor
fields.description: Bank cubic yards of cut needed per compacted cubic yard of fill.

fields.label: Limits of disturbance
fields.description: Area to be cleared and graded. Sets erosion control and land disturbance permit thresholds.

fields.label: Design rainfall intensity
fields.description: From the local intensity-duration-frequency curve for the governing storm.

fields.label: Water quality treatment depth
fields.description: Runoff depth over impervious area that must be treated.

fields.label: Pond area as share of site
fields.description: Planning estimate until a routed design exists. Underground detention drops this to near zero at higher cost.

fields.label: Pond location
fields.description: Normally at siteConditions.lowPointLocation.

fields.label: Outfall location
fields.description: Where site discharge leaves the property. Must stay at the pre-development discharge point.

fields.label: Sewer invert elevation at tie-in
fields.description: Bottom inside of the existing pipe. Controls whether gravity flow works.

fields.label: Minimum sewer slope
fields.description: About 1 percent for a 6 in service and 0.4 percent for an 8 in main.

fields.label: Drain field area including reserve
fields.description: Sized from soil percolation and design flow. A reserve field of equal size is usually required.

fields.label: Required fire flow
fields.description: Depends on building area, construction type and sprinklers.

fields.label: Available fire flow
fields.description: From a hydrant flow test at 20 psi residual.

fields.label: Maximum hydrant distance to any part of building
fields.description: Measured along the fire access route. 600 ft where the building is sprinklered.

fields.label: Maximum fire department connection distance to hydrant
Transformer pad location
fields.description: Needs clear working space, typically 10 ft in front of the doors.

fields.label: Off-site utility extension length
fields.description: Distance utilities must be extended to reach the site.

fields.label: Maximum distance from fire lane to any exterior wall
fields.description: Measured around the building along an approved route. Often extended for sprinklered buildings.

fields.label: Fire apparatus inside turning radius
fields.description: Set by the local fire marshal for the department's largest truck.

fields.label: Secondary fire access required
fields.description: Typically triggered by large building area, height, or more than 100 to 200 dwelling units.

fields.label: Disturbed area triggering a land disturbance permit
fields.description: Federal construction stormwater permitting starts at 1 acre; many localities are stricter.

fields.label: Site work cost per disturbed acre
fields.description: Clearing, grading, utilities, paving, stormwater and landscaping.

fields.label: Off-site improvement cost
fields.description: Turn lanes, signals, utility extensions.

fields.label: Soft costs
fields.description: Design, permitting, legal and financing as a share of hard cost.

usePresets.description: Values loaded into the matching fields when zoning.useType changes. Parking ratios are typical code minimums. Trip rates are rough weekday PM peak-hour approximations for early screening only and should be replaced with current ITE Trip Generation rates.

mixed_use.note: Compute each component separately, then apply parking.sharedParkingReduction.

adaAccessibleSpaces.description: Minimum accessible spaces by total spaces provided, per the 2010 ADA Standards. At least one of every six accessible spaces, or fraction of six, must be van accessible.

oneWayAisleWidthByAngle.description: Typical one-way aisle width by stall angle. Two-way aisles and fire lanes override these.

derived.label: Building envelope
derived.formula: inset(parcel.boundary after rowDedication, setbacks by side) minus easements where buildingAllowed is false, floodplainAreas, buffer(wetlands, wetlandBuffer), buffer(streams, streamBuffer)
derived.description: Where a building may be placed.

derived.label: Paving envelope
derived.formula: inset(parcel.boundary after rowDedication, buffers by side) minus easements where pavingAllowed is false, floodplainAreas, buffer(wetlands, wetlandBuffer), buffer(streams, streamBuffer), critical root zones of protectedTrees
derived.description: Where parking and drives may be placed. Usually larger than the building envelope.

derived.label: Required parking spaces
derived.formula: parkingBasis == 'per_unit' ? ceil(building.dwellingUnits * parking.ratioPerUnit * (1 - parking.sharedParkingReduction / 100)) : ceil(derived.grossFloorArea / 1000 * parking.ratioPer1000SF * (1 - parking.sharedParkingReduction / 100))

derived.label: Impervious area
derived.formula: building.footprintArea + derived.parkingArea + derived.loadingArea + area(driveways, sidewalks, pads)

derived.label: Land required by program
derived.formula: building.footprintArea + derived.parkingArea + derived.loadingArea + derived.pondArea + building.expansionArea + utilities.drainFieldArea

derived.label: Minimum finished floor elevation
derived.description: Ignore the flood term when baseFloodElevation is null.

derived.label: Gravity sewer feasible
derived.description: False means a lift station or grinder pump is needed, or the pad must be raised.

derived.label: Pre-development peak runoff
derived.description: Rational method, Q = C i A with A in acres. Suitable for small sites only.

derived.label: Cut volume
derived.formula: sum over grid cells where existing > proposed of (existing - proposed) * cellArea / 27

derived.label: Fill volume
derived.formula: sum over grid cells where proposed > existing of (proposed - existing) * cellArea / 27 * grading.shrinkSwellFactor

derived.label: Net earthwork
derived.description: Positive means export, negative means import.

complianceChecks.label: Driveway spacing and intersection clearance
complianceChecks.rule: each access point is at least access.minDrivewaySpacing from other driveways and access.minDistanceFromIntersection from intersections

complianceChecks.label: Fire lane reaches all sides
complianceChecks.rule: every exterior wall point is within fire.hoseReach of a fire lane at least fire.laneWidth wide

complianceChecks.label: Aerial access provided where required
complianceChecks.rule: building.height <= fire.aerialAccessHeightTrigger || aerial lane of fire.aerialAccessWidth is present along one full side

complianceChecks.label: Dead ends have turnarounds
complianceChecks.rule: no dead-end drive longer than fire.deadEndMaxLength without fire.turnaroundType != 'none'

complianceChecks.label: Post-development runoff exceeds pre-development
complianceChecks.description: True on almost every project; the difference sizes the detention facility.

complianceChecks.label: Accessible route slopes comply
complianceChecks.rule: running slope <= grading.accessibleRouteMaxRunningSlope && cross slope <= grading.accessibleRouteMaxCrossSlope along the route from accessible stalls and the public sidewalk to the entrance
